name: Epic Games
page_total_how: Playwright capture of the careers page (discovery/captures/epic-games, 2026-10-19) showed '156 Positions'; its own feed /site/api/v2/jobs returned total 156 = Greenhouse epicgames 135 + epicgamesportuguese 9 + epicgamesfrench 12 (each hit carries a 'board' field). The 21 Portuguese/French postings are translated copies of English-board postings (same requisition_id and same location, all 21).
notes: The English board alone holds every requisition and location (67 requisitions, 135 postings: one posting per location). Adding boards epicgamesportuguese/epicgamesfrench reproduces the site's 156 but only adds translated duplicates (e.g. 'Stagiaire en apprentissage automatique' = 'Machine Learning Intern', Montreal). The site's own API is behind a Cloudflare managed challenge (403); do not use it.
